heading.zh: 伦敦文艺行程：复活节长周末
heading.en: London: an Easter long weekend, culture first

queriedAt.zh: 2026 年 10 月 25 日（距出发约 5 个月，部分展期和演出还没公布）
queriedAt.en: 25 October 2026 (about 5 months ahead; some exhibition dates and shows aren't announced yet)

intro.zh: 3 月 26 日（周五）到、30 日（周二）走，只排中间 27、28、29 日三天。这三天正好是复活节长周末：26 日耶稣受难日和 29 日复活节星期一都是英国公共假日，28 日是复活节星期日，而且当天凌晨夏令时开始，时钟拨快 1 小时。主线：现当代艺术（Tate Modern、Tate Britain 刚开幕的 Sonia Boyce 大展）、菜市场和花市、圣保罗教堂穹顶、东区街头艺术、Barbican 粗野主义建筑，最后一天坐泰晤士河公共船去格林尼治。
intro.en: Arriving Friday 26 March and leaving Tuesday 30 March, so only the three full days, 27–29 March, are planned. They fall on the Easter long weekend: Good Friday (26th) and Easter Monday (29th) are UK bank holidays, the 28th is Easter Sunday, and that night the clocks go forward one hour. The thread: modern and contemporary art (Tate Modern, and Sonia Boyce's new show at Tate Britain), food and flower markets, the dome of St Paul's, East End street art, Barbican brutalism, and on the last day a public river boat down the Thames to Greenwich.

items.zh: Sonia Boyce 回顾展（Tate Britain）3 月 26 日刚好开幕：她是 1980 年代英国黑人艺术运动出身的艺术家，是这次最贴你「议题型现当代艺术」口味的展。
items.en: Sonia Boyce retrospective (Tate Britain) opens on 26 March: she came out of the 1980s Black British arts movement, and this is the show that best fits your taste for issue-driven contemporary art.

items.zh: Julio Le Parc：Light. Colour. Action.（Tate Modern，展到 5 月 3 日）：光、色彩、会动的装置，还有能按按钮、转动的互动房间，属于你喜欢的「奇怪当代」。
items.en: Julio Le Parc: Light. Colour. Action. (Tate Modern, until 3 May): light, colour and moving installations, plus interactive rooms with buttons and spinning parts, the kind of strange contemporary art you enjoy.

items.zh: 圣保罗大教堂：内部非常震撼，还能爬上穹顶看泰晤士河和老城，同时满足「震撼的建筑」和「登高望远」。
items.en: St Paul's Cathedral: a stunning interior, and you can climb the dome for the Thames and the old City, covering both striking architecture and a view from above.

items.zh: 泰晤士河公共船（Uber Boat）：用 contactless 刷卡就能坐，从威斯敏斯特一路坐到格林尼治约 45 分钟，伦敦版的哥本哈根港口轮渡。
items.en: Thames river bus (Uber Boat): tap in with contactless; about 45 minutes from Westminster to Greenwich, London's answer to the Copenhagen harbour buses.

items.zh: Columbia Road 花市 + 肖迪奇街头艺术 + Barbican：一个周日把东区的另类气质和粗野主义建筑串在一起。
items.en: Columbia Road flower market + Shoreditch street art + the Barbican: one Sunday linking the East End's alternative streak with brutalist architecture.

alerts.zh: 大英博物馆的贝叶挂毯（Bayeux Tapestry）是这几年伦敦最轰动的展，但 3 月 31 日前的票已经全部售罄，4 月以后的票 2027 年初才开售。你的日期赶不上，除非之后官方放出退票。
alerts.en: The Bayeux Tapestry at the British Museum is London's blockbuster of the decade, but tickets up to 31 March are sold out, and April onwards goes on sale in early 2027. Your dates miss it unless returns are released.

alerts.zh: 伦敦大部分大型博物馆常设展免费，只有特展收费，所以 London Pass 这类城市卡对这个行程不划算，交通直接用 contactless 刷卡（每天自动封顶）即可。
alerts.en: Most big London museums have free permanent collections and charge only for special exhibitions, so a city pass like the London Pass doesn't pay off for this plan; just tap contactless for transport (it caps daily).

alerts.zh: 复活节期间 Borough Market 等地的营业时间可能调整，官网只写了「公共假日时间会变」，出发前一周再看一次。
alerts.en: Opening hours at Borough Market and elsewhere may change over Easter; the website only says bank-holiday hours vary, so check again a week before.

name.zh: Comedy Store 周末脱口秀 The Best in Stand Up
name.en: Comedy Store weekend stand-up: The Best in Stand Up

why.zh: 周五、周六晚的固定拼盘场，复活节长周末容易满。只限 18 岁以上，带证件。
why.en: The regular Friday and Saturday night line-up show; it fills up over a long weekend. 18+ only, bring ID.

deadline.zh: 开票后尽快（票价还没公布）
deadline.en: As soon as they go on sale (price not yet announced)

why.zh: 开幕第一个周末加上复活节假期，限时入场的时段会紧张。
why.en: Opening weekend plus the Easter holiday, so timed-entry slots will be tight.

why.zh: 展期最后一个多月，周末人多。
why.en: It's the show's last month or so, and weekends are busy.

deadline.en: 1–2 weeks ahead, on the official site

why.zh: 成人 £27。复活节前的周六可能因礼拜调整开放时间，订票时看官网日历；周日不对游客开放。
why.en: Adults £27. Holy Saturday hours may change for services; check the calendar when booking. No sightseeing on Sundays.

name.zh: GuruWalk：City of London 主题导览
name.en: GuruWalk: City of London themed tour

deadline.zh: 出发前几天在 GuruWalk 登记
deadline.en: Register on GuruWalk a few days before

why.zh: 免费、自愿付小费，登记一下保证有位置。
why.en: Free, pay what you like; registering secures a place.

why.zh: 只能关注官网退票。
why.en: Only returns on the official site are left.

skipNote.zh: 3 月 26 日（周五）到达、3 月 30 日（周二）离开，这两天白天不排；但 26 日晚上可以去 Comedy Store 看脱口秀（见「演出」部分）。
skipNote.en: Arriving Friday 26 March and leaving Tuesday 30 March, so those daytimes aren't planned; but on the evening of the 26th you could catch stand-up at the Comedy Store (see "Shows").

theme.zh: 市场、帝国的另一面、圣保罗和 Tate Modern
theme.en: Markets, the other side of empire, St Paul's and Tate Modern

note.zh: 全天都在泰晤士河两岸，步行加一段过桥。日落约 18:30，Tate Modern 周六开到 21:00，正好在顶层看日落。
note.en: The whole day stays on both banks of the Thames, on foot with one bridge crossing. Sunset is about 18:30, and Tate Modern is open until 21:00 on Saturdays, perfect for sunset from the top floor.

why.zh: 伦敦最老的食品市场，周六是全场最齐的一天，早点去人少。
why.en: London's oldest food market; Saturday is the fullest day, and it's quieter early.

name.zh: City of London 导览：From Sugar & Slaves to Tea & Opium
name.en: City of London tour: From Sugar & Slaves to Tea & Opium

area.zh: Monument 旁集合（走过伦敦桥约 10 分钟）
area.en: Meet by the Monument (about 10 minutes' walk across London Bridge)

why.zh: GuruWalk 4.93 分（2,416 条评价），讲金融城怎么靠糖、奴隶贸易、茶和鸦片发家，就是你喜欢的「Politically Incorrect」那种讲城市另一面的导览。
why.en: GuruWalk 4.93 (2,416 reviews): how the City grew rich on sugar, the slave trade, tea and opium. Exactly the "Politically Incorrect" kind of tour that shows a city's other side.

booking.zh: 提前在 GuruWalk 登记；介绍里注明不适合小孩，内容比较沉重。
booking.en: Register on GuruWalk in advance; the listing says it's not for children, as the content is heavy.

name.zh: 圣保罗大教堂 + 穹顶

hours.zh: 参观 8:30 起，最晚 16:00 入场

why.zh: 内部是巴洛克穹顶加金色马赛克；爬上穹顶的回廊，看到的是泰晤士河、老城和对岸的 Tate Modern，不是一片没特色的楼。
why.en: A baroque dome and golden mosaics inside; from the dome galleries you look over the Thames, the old City and Tate Modern across the river, not a wall of anonymous towers.

booking.zh: 复活节前的周六，出发前看官网日历确认开放时间。
booking.en: Holy Saturday: check the official calendar for opening hours before you go.

name.zh: 千禧桥 → Tate Modern：Julio Le Parc 特展 + 常设馆
name.en: Millennium Bridge → Tate Modern: Julio Le Parc + the collection

hours.en: Open until 21:00 on Fridays and Saturdays

why.zh: Le Parc 的光、镜面、会动的彩色装置，还有可以按按钮、转动的「游戏室」；常设馆免费，顺便看 Turbine Hall。Monet 特展（展到 6 月 27 日）也在，但偏古典，时间不够就跳过。
why.en: Le Parc's light, mirrors and moving coloured installations, plus a "games room" with buttons and spinning parts; the collection is free, and the Turbine Hall is on the way. The Monet show (until 27 June) is also on but more classical; skip it if time is short.

booking.zh: Le Parc 是收费特展，提前买票。
booking.en: Le Parc is a paid exhibition; buy tickets ahead.

why.zh: 正对圣保罗穹顶和泰晤士河的日落，就在馆里，不用另外跑。
why.en: Sunset facing the dome of St Paul's and the Thames, right inside the museum.

name.zh: Comedy Store：The Best in Stand Up（可选）
name.en: Comedy Store: The Best in Stand Up (optional)

area.zh: Piccadilly Circus 旁，地铁约 15 分钟
area.en: By Piccadilly Circus, about 15 minutes by Tube

why.zh: 伦敦最有名的脱口秀俱乐部的周末拼盘场，英语，题材很杂。
why.en: The weekend line-up at London's most famous comedy club; in English, all sorts of material.

booking.en: Shows usually at 18:30 / 19:30 / 21:30, check the site; 18+, bring ID.

backup.zh: 下雨照常（大部分在室内）。圣保罗如果复活节前不对游客开放，换成 Sky Garden（免费，要提前订）或 Leake Street 涂鸦隧道。
backup.en: Rain doesn't matter (mostly indoors). If St Paul's isn't open to visitors before Easter, swap in Sky Garden (free, book ahead) or the Leake Street graffiti tunnel.

date.zh: 3 月 28 日 周日（复活节）

theme.zh: 花市、东区街头艺术、Barbican 粗野主义
theme.en: Flower market, East End street art, Barbican brutalism

note.zh: 凌晨 1 点时钟拨快 1 小时，早上会觉得早一个钟头。日落约 19:30，傍晚去 Parliament Hill 看整片城市。
note.en: Clocks go forward one hour at 1 a.m., so the morning will feel an hour early. Sunset is about 19:30; end the day on Parliament Hill looking over the whole city.

why.zh: 整条维多利亚小街都是卖花的摊位，两边是小店和咖啡馆；复活节前后正好是春天的花。
why.en: A whole Victorian street of flower stalls, lined with small shops and cafés; around Easter it's full of spring flowers.

booking.zh: 复活节星期日是否照常开，出发前看 columbiaroadmarket.co.uk。
booking.en: Check columbiaroadmarket.co.uk to confirm it runs on Easter Sunday.

name.zh: 肖迪奇和 Brick Lane 街头艺术
name.en: Shoreditch and Brick Lane street art

why.zh: 伦敦最密集的涂鸦和街头艺术区，周日 Brick Lane 还有跳蚤市场和各国小吃，是这次最接近柏林 Neurotitan 气质的地方。想听讲解可以改跟 11:00 的街头艺术导览（见下面的导览列表）。
why.en: London's densest graffiti and street-art area; on Sundays Brick Lane also has flea markets and food from everywhere. The closest thing on this trip to Berlin's Neurotitan. For commentary, join the 11:00 street-art tour instead (see the tours list).

area.zh: Barbican，从 Brick Lane 步行约 25 分钟
area.en: Barbican, about 25 minutes' walk from Brick Lane

why.zh: 粗野主义住宅区、水池和空中步道，整个建筑群就是展品；The Curve 3–5 月是印度摄影师 Dayanita Singh 的「可移动博物馆」装置（免费）。温室（Conservatory）开放日不固定，碰上了一定进去。
why.en: Brutalist housing, lakes and high walkways: the whole estate is the exhibit. The Curve hosts Indian photographer Dayanita Singh's "museum" installation in spring (free). The Conservatory opens on irregular days; go in if you're lucky.

booking.zh: Dayanita Singh 展还没公布确切开幕日；温室开放日以 Barbican 官网为准。
booking.en: The Dayanita Singh show's exact opening date isn't announced yet; check Conservatory days on the Barbican site.

area.zh: Overground 到 Gospel Oak，约 35 分钟
area.en: Overground to Gospel Oak, about 35 minutes

why.zh: 城里的小山丘，日落时看整条天际线，圣保罗穹顶在受保护的视线走廊里；山下就是荒野和池塘，很像你喜欢的「城里爬山」。
why.en: A hill in the city with the whole skyline at sunset, St Paul's dome sitting in a protected view corridor; below is heath and ponds, very much your kind of "climb a hill in town".

backup.zh: 下雨：Barbican 待久一点，或者去 V&A 的 Punk to Pop（3 月 13 日开幕，讲 70 年代亚文化和朋克，很合另类口味）。
backup.en: If it rains: stay longer at the Barbican, or go to Punk to Pop at the V&A (opens 13 March; 1970s subcultures and punk, right up the alternative alley).

date.zh: 3 月 29 日 周一（复活节星期一，公共假日）

theme.zh: Sonia Boyce、坐船顺泰晤士河去格林尼治
theme.en: Sonia Boyce, then down the Thames by boat to Greenwich

note.zh: Borough Market 周一不开，今天不排市场。日落约 19:30，最后在格林尼治公园山顶看日落。
note.en: Borough Market is closed on Mondays, so no market today. Sunset is about 19:30; finish on the hill in Greenwich Park.

why.zh: 她 40 年创作的第一次大型回顾，装置、拼贴、影像、和公众一起做的 Devotional 档案；1980 年代英国黑人艺术运动出身，议题型，和你在 Louisiana 喜欢的那类展最接近。
why.en: The first major survey of her 40-year practice: installation, collage, film, and the Devotional archive made with the public. Issue-driven and rooted in the 1980s Black British arts movement, it's the closest match to the shows you loved at Louisiana.

booking.zh: 票价还没公布，开票后提前买。
booking.en: Price not yet announced; book once tickets are out.

why.zh: 伦敦的公共河上巴士，一路经过国会大厦、圣保罗、伦敦塔桥、金丝雀码头，再到格林尼治，当交通也当观光。
why.en: London's public river bus, past Parliament, St Paul's, Tower Bridge and Canary Wharf to Greenwich: transport and sightseeing in one.

why.zh: 整面墙和天花板都是巴洛克壁画的大厅，被称作「英国的西斯廷礼拜堂」，属于你说的「建筑本身震撼」那一类。有免费讲解（11:45、12:45、14:45、15:45）。
why.en: A hall with walls and ceiling covered in baroque painting, called "Britain's Sistine Chapel"; firmly in your "the building itself is the show" category. Free talks at 11:45, 12:45, 14:45 and 15:45.

booking.zh: 偶尔因私人活动临时关闭，出发前看官网关闭公告。
booking.en: Occasionally closes at short notice for private events; check the closures notice before you go.

name.zh: 格林尼治街区和 Greenwich Market

why.zh: 带顶棚的老市场，有手作摊位和小吃，周围是乔治时代的老街。
why.en: A covered historic market with craft stalls and street food, surrounded by Georgian streets.

name.zh: 格林尼治公园山顶（皇家天文台旁）
name.en: Top of Greenwich Park (by the Royal Observatory)

why.zh: 脚下是旧海军学院的双穹顶和泰晤士河，对岸是金丝雀码头，是伦敦最经典的日落观景点之一。
why.en: Below you are the twin domes of the Old Royal Naval College and the Thames, with Canary Wharf across the water; one of London's classic sunset views.

backup.zh: 下雨：Painted Hall 之后去旁边的国家海事博物馆（免费）。今晚是这个月最后一个周一，Comedy Store 有 'King Gong 开放麦（观众可以把演员「敲」下台）。
backup.en: If it rains: after the Painted Hall, go next door to the National Maritime Museum (free). Tonight is the last Monday of the month, so the Comedy Store runs its 'King Gong open mic (the audience can gong acts off stage).

why.zh: 英国黑人艺术运动出身的艺术家，第一次大型回顾。
why.en: First major retrospective of an artist from the Black British arts movement.

exhibitions.title: Julio Le Parc: Light. Colour. Action.

why.zh: 60 多件光、色彩、动态和互动作品，展线像迷宫。
why.en: Over 60 works of light, colour, motion and interaction, laid out like a maze.

why.zh: 70 年代亚文化怎么变成朋克，又怎么影响音乐、艺术和时装。
why.en: How 1970s subcultures became punk, and how punk shaped music, art and fashion.

until.zh: 2027 年 5 月（开幕日待公布）

why.zh: 柚木做的「可移动博物馆」装置，讲印度古典音乐对她 50 年创作的影响。
why.en: A teak "mobile museum" installation on how Indian classical music shaped her 50 years of work.

why.zh: Tate Modern 第一次办莫奈专题。偏古典，不在主线，时间多再看。
why.en: Tate Modern's first Monet show. More classical and off the main thread; see it if you have time.

showsNote.zh: 查了 Ticketmaster、The O2 日程、Songkick、British Comedy Guide 巡演表、Comedy Store 和 Eventim Apollo。这几天没有麦莉·赛勒斯那种量级的流行巨星演出，O2 这几天是电子 DJ（26 日 Sub Focus、27 日 Sonny Fodera）和金属乐队（28 日 Ice Nine Kills）。差几天的：Olivia Rodrigo 4 月 5 日起在 O2 连开多场，比你离开晚一周。Trevor Noah、黄阿丽、Mario Adrion 都没查到 2027 年 3 月的伦敦场次，演员的巡演通常提前几个月才公布，出发前一个月再查一次。
showsNote.en: Checked Ticketmaster, The O2's calendar, Songkick, the British Comedy Guide tour list, the Comedy Store and Eventim Apollo. No Miley Cyrus-scale pop stars play these dates; The O2 has electronic DJs (Sub Focus on the 26th, Sonny Fodera on the 27th) and a metal band (Ice Nine Kills on the 28th). Just missed: Olivia Rodrigo plays several nights at The O2 from 5 April, a week after you leave. No March 2027 London dates found for Trevor Noah, Ali Wong or Mario Adrion; comedy tours are often announced only a few months out, so check again a month before.

name.zh: Comedy Store：The Best in Stand Up
name.en: Comedy Store: The Best in Stand Up

date.zh: 每周四、五、六晚（3 月 26、27 日都有）
date.en: Every Thu, Fri and Sat night (on 26 and 27 March)

why.zh: 伦敦最老牌的脱口秀俱乐部，周末拼盘场，常有电视上的熟面孔。
why.en: London's best-known comedy club; the weekend line-up often has faces from TV.

date.zh: 每周日 19:30 左右（3 月 28 日）

why.zh: 老牌即兴喜剧团，现场根据观众点子即兴演。
why.en: A long-running improv troupe making scenes from audience suggestions.

date.zh: 每月最后一个周一 19:30 左右（3 月 29 日）
date.en: Last Monday of the month, around 19:30 (29 March)

why.zh: 新人开放麦，观众可以把不好笑的演员「敲锣」赶下台，很热闹。
why.en: An open mic for new acts where the audience can gong unfunny comics off stage; rowdy fun.

why.zh: 1984 年伦敦的同性恋活动者跑去支援威尔士罢工矿工，真实事件，又好笑又感人；性别和政治议题都有。
why.en: In 1984 London gay and lesbian activists back striking Welsh miners. A true story, funny and moving, touching both gender and politics.

why.zh: 20 世纪初伦敦洗衣女工卷入女性选举权运动。
why.en: London laundry workers drawn into the fight for women's votes in the early 20th century.

why.zh: 轻松好笑的伦敦，诺丁山、移民社区和城市的善意。
why.en: A light, funny London: Notting Hill, immigrant communities and a kind city.

why.zh: 五部电影组成的选集，讲 1960–80 年代伦敦西印度群岛移民社区和种族歧视；正好是 Sonia Boyce 成长的那个伦敦。
why.en: An anthology of five films about London's West Indian community and racism from the 1960s to the 80s; the very London Sonia Boyce grew up in.

why.zh: 用档案影像拼出 20 世纪伦敦：移民、朋克、骚乱、战争，节奏很快。看完再去 V&A 的 Punk to Pop 更有感觉。
why.en: Twentieth-century London cut together from archive footage: immigration, punk, riots, war, at a fast pace. Watch it before the V&A's Punk to Pop.

why.zh: 按主题而不是按年代写的伦敦史，写街道、气味、监狱、河流，适合挑章节读。
why.en: A history of London organised by theme rather than date: streets, smells, prisons, the river. Good to dip into by chapter.

why.zh: 伦敦北部三个移民家庭的几十年，又好笑又尖锐，写身份和文化差异。
why.en: Decades in the lives of three immigrant families in north London; funny and sharp on identity and cultural difference.

mediaNote.zh: 都是英语原版，书都有中文译本。你看过、喜欢的告诉我，之后会加进 skill 里去重。
mediaNote.en: All in English; the books all have Chinese translations. Tell me what you've seen and liked, and I'll add it to the skill so it isn't recommended again.

tours.name: City of London: From Sugar & Slaves to Tea & Opium

why.zh: 已排进第 1 天。讲大英帝国贸易的黑暗面，Monument 旁集合。
why.en: Already in day 1. The dark side of British imperial trade; meets by the Monument.

tours.name: The Iconic Street Art Tour: Shoreditch, Banksy and Hidden Gems

why.zh: 第 2 天可以替换自己逛；Shoreditch High Street 站外集合，导游拿红伞。周日是否有场次要看 GuruWalk 日历。
why.en: Can replace the self-guided walk on day 2; meets outside Shoreditch High Street station, guide with a red umbrella. Check the GuruWalk calendar for Sunday slots.

tours.name: London - An Essential History: Art, Architecture, Politics and Monarchy

why.zh: 伦敦这次评分最高的老城导览，政治和建筑都讲。
why.en: The highest-rated old-town tour this time, covering politics and architecture.

toursNote.zh: 门槛：GuruWalk 评分 ≥ 4.7、评价 ≥ 300 条；主题型优先。
toursNote.en: Threshold: GuruWalk rating ≥ 4.7 with ≥ 300 reviews; themed tours preferred.

why.zh: 伦敦最大的皇家公园，600 多头野鹿自由走动，补上你在哥本哈根没去成的鹿园。半天。
why.en: London's largest royal park, with 600-plus free-roaming deer; makes up for the Copenhagen deer park you missed. Half a day.

why.zh: 你很喜欢布达佩斯国会，这里的上下议院内部也非常华丽。周六有导览，议会休会期间周一到周六都有，要提前在官网订。
why.en: You loved Budapest's parliament; the Commons and Lords interiors here are just as lavish. Tours run on Saturdays, and Monday to Saturday during recess; book ahead on the official site.

why.zh: 维多利亚画家的故居，Arab Hall 用伊斯兰瓷砖和金色马赛克铺满，很装饰。
why.en: A Victorian painter's home whose Arab Hall is covered in Islamic tiles and gold mosaic; highly decorative.

why.zh: 70 年代亚文化和朋克，3 月 13 日开幕。V&A 主楼本身也很华丽。
why.en: 1970s subcultures and punk, opening 13 March. The V&A building itself is lavish too.

why.zh: 带室内花园的观景层，能看到伦敦塔桥和泰晤士河；但周围都是金融城高楼，所以没排进主线。要提前在官网订免费票。
why.en: A viewing level with an indoor garden, looking at Tower Bridge and the Thames; but it's surrounded by City towers, so it's not on the main route. Book free tickets ahead.

why.zh: 运河边的旧仓库改造区（Coal Drops Yard）和船屋，一路走到 Camden 的另类市场。
why.en: Converted canal-side warehouses (Coal Drops Yard) and narrowboats, walking all the way to Camden's alternative markets.

name.zh: 帝国战争博物馆：大屠杀展厅
name.en: Imperial War Museum: The Holocaust Galleries

why.zh: 沉重历史，展陈做得很好，离 Tate Britain 不远。
why.en: Difficult history, very well presented, not far from Tate Britain.

distance.zh: 火车到 Salisbury 约 1.5 小时，再转专线巴士
distance.en: About 1.5 hours by train to Salisbury, then a dedicated bus

why.zh: 超出 1 小时圈，但非常有名，要整整一天；三天都排满了，只放在这里备选。
why.en: Outside the 1-hour radius but very famous; it takes a full day, and all three days are full, so it's here as an alternative.

booking.zh: English Heritage 官网分时段订票，复活节假期人多。
booking.en: Timed tickets on the English Heritage site; busy over Easter.

why.zh: 3 月 31 日前的票已经售罄；馆内其他藏品以古代文物为主，不在你的偏好里。
why.en: Tickets before 31 March are sold out, and the rest of the collection is mostly antiquities, outside your interests.

name.zh: 国家美术馆（含 Van Eyck 特展）
name.en: National Gallery (including the Van Eyck show)

why.zh: 以古典大师油画为主。
why.en: Mostly Old Master paintings.

why.zh: 价格高，看到的大部分是新楼。
why.en: Expensive, and the view is mostly new towers.

why.zh: 打卡和购物，不合口味。
why.en: Photo stops and shopping, not your thing.

paragraphs.zh: 排程假设：住市中心、全程公共交通（contactless 刷卡，每天自动封顶）；日落时间按 3 月底估算（27 日约 18:30，夏令时后约 19:30）。
paragraphs.en: Planning assumptions: staying centrally, public transport throughout (contactless, daily cap); sunset times estimated for late March (about 18:30 on the 27th, about 19:30 after the clocks change).

paragraphs.zh: 已核对：Tate 两个特展的展期、Borough Market 周六营业时间、圣保罗参观时间和票价、Painted Hall 开放时间、贝叶挂毯售票情况、GuruWalk 评分。还没公布或要出发前再查：Sonia Boyce 票价、Dayanita Singh 开幕日、Barbican 温室开放日、复活节期间的市场时间、Comedy Store 3 月场次。
paragraphs.en: Verified: dates of both Tate shows, Borough Market Saturday hours, St Paul's hours and price, Painted Hall hours, Bayeux Tapestry ticket status, GuruWalk ratings. Not yet announced or to recheck before departure: Sonia Boyce ticket price, Dayanita Singh opening date, Barbican Conservatory days, Easter market hours, Comedy Store March listings.

paragraphs.zh: 官方旅游网站 visitlondon.com 的活动日历还没有 2027 年 3 月的内容，演出部分改查票务平台和场馆日程。
paragraphs.en: The official visitlondon.com events calendar has no March 2027 listings yet, so shows were checked on ticketing platforms and venue calendars instead.
